This approach exploits the fact that the maximum overlap integral corresponds to specific frequency components that dominate the correlation, enabling targeted suppression.

The key innovation is the use of orthogonal basis functions with controlled spectral content to ensure the solution meets integral constraints while minimizing coherence across shifts. This avoids the local minima issues of gradient-based methods by constructing the solution in a structured, mathematically principled way.
